author_comment.body:
@laurynmm Here is the visual comparison showing the CSS variable change in dark mode:

![Arrow color fix - before and after in dark mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cms19859230182-lang/zulip/pr-assets/popover-arrow-fix-demo.png)

**Before (left):** Arrow uses `hsl(211.58deg 33.33% 11.18%)` — a bluish dark gray that visibly mismatches the popover header/footer background.

**After (right):** Arrow uses `hsl(0deg 0% 0% / 20%)` — identical to `--color-background-emoji-picker-popover`, making the arrow seamlessly blend with the emoji picker popover background.

The change is purely a CSS variable color value correction. The existing CSS rules already reference `--color-border-emoji-picker-tippy-arrow` for the arrow color — this PR just fixes the variable's dark mode value to match the background it sits against.
